chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan narrated to me from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from al-Hasan ibn Musa al-Khashab, from Abdillah ibn Jabalah, from Ghiyath ibn Kalub, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): 'O Abu Abdillah, inform me about the best times for the Fajr prayer.'
He replied: 'At the time of the dawn.'
Indeed, the recitation of the Qur'an at dawn is ever witnessed.
Meaning the Fajr prayer; it is witnessed by the angels of the day and the angels of the night.
So when the servant prays the Subh (morning) prayer at the start of dawn, its reward is recorded for him twice, recorded by the angels of the night and the angels of the day.

key_terms.قُرْآنَ الْفَجْرِ: recitation of the Qur'an at dawn

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of praying Fajr at dawn according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration to highlight the spiritual significance of the Fajr prayer's transition period, where the 'witnessed' recitation is interpreted by the Imams as the prayer itself being observed by the rotating angels of night and day. This dual witnessing underscores the concept of continuous divine surveillance and grants the believer a multiplied reward, reinforcing the practice of praying at the very onset of dawn (Tulūʿ al-Fajr) as the most virtuous time.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. It was narrated to me by Muhammad b. al-Hassan from Muhammad b. al-Hassan al-Saffar from al-Hassan b. Musa al-Khashab from Abdillah b. Jabalah from Ghiyath b. Kalub from Ishaq b. Ammar who said:
I asked Abi Abdillah (a.s.): "Oh Aba Abdillah, inform me about the best times during the Fajr prayer."
He replied: "It is at the time of the dawn.
Verily, Allah, the Most High, says, 'Indeed, the recitation of the Qur'an at dawn is ever witnessed.' [17:78].
Meaning, it is witnessed by the angels of the day and the angels of the night.
So when the servant prays Salaat al-Subh at the start of dawn, its reward would be noted down twice, noted by the angels of the night and the angels of the day.”
